rows.ARS:
Orange-pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: HARrowbond
Exhibition name: Rosemary Harkness
rows.Origin:
Bred by Harkness & Co. (United Kingdom, 1985).
Introduced in United Kingdom by R Harkness & Co. Ltd. in 1985 as 'Rosemary Harkness'.
rows.Bloom: Orange-pink. Strong, sweet fragrance. 35 petals. Double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Height: 30" to 3' (75 to 90cm). Width: 30" to 32" (75 to 80cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 5b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) . Can be grown in the ground or in a container (container requires winter protection).
